observations: White gaming console with the distinct curved form factor of a PlayStation 5 Disc Edition.
A disc slot is visible on the lower section of the console in both photos.
The console is placed on a green pool table in what appears to be a gaming lounge or shop.
Watermark 'TEEZ GADGETS AND GAMING' and 'POSTED ON JIJI' are present across the center of both images.
No controller, power cables, or HDMI cables are shown in the photos.
The two photos provided are nearly identical in angle, showing only one side of the device.

claims.evidence: The physical design and disc slot in photos 0 and 1 are unique to the PlayStation 5 Disc Edition.
No controller is visible in any of the provided photos.

risks.risk: The console may be non-functional or have a faulty HDMI output.
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on and displaying the system dashboard on a television.

risks.risk: The mentioned controller may be missing, a third-party replica, or have mechanical issues like stick drift.
risks.proof: A photo of the controller and a video of it being used to navigate the console menu.

risks.risk: The disc drive may be unable to read or eject discs.
risks.proof: A video showing a disc being inserted, the game icon appearing on the menu, and the disc being ejected.
risks.if_unproven: As having a broken disc drive.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from PlayStation Network (PSN) services.
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully connecting to the PlayStation Store or logging into a PSN account.

proof_requests: Photo of the controller mentioned in the description.
Video of the console turned on and connected to a TV showing the home screen.
Video demonstrating the disc drive functionality with a game disc.
Photo of the serial number and model number sticker located on the base or back of the console.
response.reason: The item is identifiable by its unique design as a PlayStation 5 Disc Edition. Due to the lack of functional proof and the absence of the mentioned controller in the photos, it is priced at its worst-case value as a non-functional console unit only.
